newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly unchanged.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly unchanged on Friday, capping a week of subdued activity, dealers said.
"There is no interest demand wise," a North Carolina dealer said. He added the hot temperatures continued to have animals eating less feed in his region.
Adequate pastures from Kansas to Texas also lessened the need for supplemental feed.
But in north Texas, one dealer noted that he ran out of next week's supply due to nearby supply tightness.
